title: Respect people who hate motion
why_it_matters: Animations can cause real discomfort, and this is a one-time fix.
explanation: Some users turn on a reduce-motion setting because movement makes them dizzy. The prefers-reduced-motion media query lets you detect it. Wrap your animations in it, or switch them off for those users.
try_it: Turn on reduce motion in your OS settings and check that your site is calmer.
